title: Vikram and Betal: The Careful Planner
moral: Planning and patience lead to success.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a careful boy.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a boy who planned his work.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The friends rushed and their bridge broke.
scenes.image_prompt: bridge breaking with friends surprised cartoon

scenes.text: The boy measured and built slowly.
scenes.image_prompt: boy measuring and building bridge cartoon

scenes.text: The boy’s bridge was strong and safe.
People used the bridge safely. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.

story: A boy built a strong bridge through planning and patience, unlike his friends who rushed. Vikram said careful planning leads to success.
